turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    subgraph ASSAY[ASSAY — read-only]
        C[Read document]
        D[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
        E[Compress to floor residue]
        F[Name evaporated content]
        G[Locate operative sentence]
        H[Report ratio, erosion direction, and flags]
        I[Output finding]
        J([This is a finding, not a draft.])
        C --> D --> E --> F --> G --> H --> I --> J
    end

    subgraph PROVIDE[PROVIDE — negotiation side]
        K[Identify mode]
        L{Mode and floor complete?}
        M[Ask up to three largest questions]
        N[State assumptions for remaining gaps]
        O[Wait for answer]
        P[Compress prompt]
        Q{Floor still passes?}
        R[Restore last passing version]
        S{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
        T[Contract is minimal]
        U[Output optimized prompt]
        V[Ask gate question]

        K --> L
        L -- No --> M --> N --> O --> L
        L -- Yes --> P --> Q
        Q -- No --> R --> T
        Q -- Yes --> S
        S -- No --> P
        S -- Yes --> T --> U --> V
    end

    A --> K
    A --> C
    V --> W{Human named signer freezes?}
    W -- No --> P
    W -- Yes --> X{Execution tools available?}
    X -- No --> Y[Gate stays closed]
    X -- Yes --> Z[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    Z --> AA{Result}
    AA -- Success --> AB[Done]
    AA -- Floor failure --> AC[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    AC --> P
```
